lines.en: I can do anything I want.
And for the most part, I have.
My life is a series of resets and repeats — one where I return to the same habits and hobbies I’ve blanketed myself in because I’m always in need of warmth. Always in need of something.
And right now, that something is air.
I’ve expelled my worries from the depths of my lungs in an attempt to envelop myself in happier days, but I’ve been left a step or two away from suffocating and must now replenish what I’ve lost.
I’m not sure how a blanket is going to help me in this case, though.
And while I’m trying a little harder than I have been to not immediately think of fashioning it into something I can hang myself with (for Ami’s sake), that’s the only thing that comes to mind.

The problem is, that puts me in quite the predicament as I’m now going to die in this metaphor no matter what I do considering my options are “hang” or “stop breathing.” Both of which are essentially interchangeable.
So for the sake of my life and your entertainment, please allow me to start all over.
I can do anything I want.
And for the most part, I have.
So maybe tonight, I’ll reset or repeat something meaningful.
Maybe tonight, I’ll replay something I haven’t seen in quite some time — a silent, contemplative night with a younger girl that doesn’t end in sex.
We have been here before.
But that was before I knew that she knew something.
: Well, if it isn’t Uta Ushibori.
That’s okay, though.
Because we both want to ignore it.
: What...what are you doing out here? It’s kind of late, isn’t it?
: I’m on my way back from your room.
: My room? But-
: Hey, wait a second! Are you actually on your way back from my room? Or are you just repeating our dialogue from the last time we met like this?!
: I’m surprised you remember that.
: I’m surprised you remember. Aren’t you supposed to have memory issues or something? Or is Uta-chan just so unforgettable that she’s exempt from them?
: You’ve always been my favorite, after all.
: By design, of course. Uta-chan is the result of painstaking research into the entire concept of cuteness. Your love for her is simply a byproduct of my hard work.
: Are you free again tonight?
: Heh...
: It doesn’t really matter if I’m free or not. I don’t know how to say no to you.
: Technically, you’ve said no to me probably a thousand times now. You definitely know how.
: I’ve said no to sexy stuff because my chastity must be protected at all costs or humanity will collapse. I’d never turn down an invitation like this, though.
: But I guess that doesn’t really matter since I’m free anyway.
: So you were just giving me the runaround out of habit?
: Would you expect any less at this point?
: Depends on which Uta I’m talking to. One of them is actually really nervous all the time.
: I’m pretty sure that one’s busy tonight. But Uta-chan can keep you company so long as you promise to keep your hands in the vehicle at all times.
: Are we just returning to our spot, then? Or did you want to try somewhere else tonight?
: It’s cute that you’d call it “our spot.”
: That’s what it is, isn’t it?
: Doesn’t change how cute it is.
: Is Uta-chan allowed to be so forward with her flirting? Or did you want to try and add a few more suggestive layers to those past couple sentences?
: It doesn’t matter how many layers there are when I’m just going to wind up shedding all of them for you no matter what happens.
: Come on! Let’s head to our spot.
So far, so good, I guess.
Uta seems a little off. But I imagine it’s hard not being a little off when you’re alone in the dark with a man who could lift you up and carry you away without any effort at all.
I doubt tonight’s the night for that, though.
And to be honest, I doubt I’ll even have Uta-chan for much longer as its only a matter of time until we have to address the elephant in the gazebo.
If Io knows, Uta knows.
And if Uta knows...
I don’t know.
I have no idea what she’ll do.
And based on her rare silence, I’m not sure she does either.
: So...what’s new, Sensei? How are things now that life is getting back to normal for you?
: Horrible. But I have a daughter now, so that’s new.
: You what?! With who?! And how do you just casually drop a bomb like that without even changing expressions?!
: Relax. I’m just talking about Ami.
: You had a baby with Ami?! Is that why she was acting so hormonal at the maid cafe the other day?!
: No, Ami is the daughter I’m referring to. We decided it’s best if she stops calling me her uncle and- wait, what do you mean “hormonal?”
: Nothing.
: Uta...if Ami is acting strange again, I need to know. I had a feeling she wasn’t ready to go back to work yet, but she’s been adamant about getting out of the house and-
: Yeah, I don’t know what you’re thinking might have happened, but I can promise you it was something completely different.
: Different...how?
: Hey! Here’s a new topic! Have you seen Io lately?
: ...Sensei?
: Why do you ask?
: Just...cause she’s been acting a little weird, that’s all. She’s staying over at the bathhouse more often than normal, so I wasn’t sure if something happened with you or...
: If maybe she's still upset about something else that happened or...
: I haven’t seen her, no.
: Really?
: Yeah. I’ve been too busy trying to get my life back in order.
: Darn it. It’s probably just her stupid brain being a stupid brain again, then.
: I keep trying to check on her, but she’s being really stubborn about dealing with stuff on her own this time.
: I just hope she doesn’t hurt herself. But if you don’t know anything, I guess I shouldn’t get you involved.
Has Io really not said anything to Uta about what happened at the bathhouse the other night?
That’s both a huge relief and...also kind of worrying. I didn’t think she kept secrets from Uta like that.
Is it possible she...doesn’t know about the picture, then?
Am I in the clear?
: Anything else you want to tell me about, though?
Ah...
Of course that’d be too simple.
: Can we maybe just stand here in silence for a little while longer?
: Sure.
: But if you have something you want to talk to me about, now’s the time to do it.
: There’s no one else around. I’m the only one who will hear whatever it is you have to say.
: And I might talk a lot...but I’m a good listener, Sensei. I promise to hear you out no matter what it is.
And just like that, the tone shifts.
Just like that, the mirage vanishes — and in its place sits the sad truth of a sad man, blaming sadness for all of the sad things he does.
It’s him and some girl — barely up to his shoulders in height. One who’s made some questionable decisions in the past, but doesn’t really deserve any of the bad things that have happened to her.
Yet here she is, putting herself in harm’s way once more. Like she wants bad things to happen to her.
Or at least that’s what I’d say if I didn’t know her as well as I do now.
Now, I know that it’s less about a love for danger, and more about being so desperate for something good to happen that she’ll put herself at risk over and over and over again.
It’s kind of sickening, really — that level of carelessness. Of stupidity. How she runs the ramps of recklessness in a way that sends that tiny body of hers speeding toward inevitable destruction.
But at the end, there is no blanket — nor a pit of foam to break her fall.
It’s just me — with arms stretched out wide, staring deep into her soul as if to say “I will be that good thing.” But I am the devil.
I am the snake crawling up her leg.
The shadow of a past that she wishes to escape, yet can’t bring herself to stop looking back at.
It may not have started with me...and it may not end with me either.
But I will be a pit stop on her long road to hell if this side of her never changes.
: Why don’t you ask me a question?
: A question?...
: Yeah. As many as you want, actually.
: Why?
: It’ll be easier to tell you if I don’t have to take the initiative.
: So you want to, like...turn it into a game?
: Cowardly, I know.
: No, I get it...
: Talking about stuff can be hard. I see that all the time in all sorts of people. I’m not really an exception either. Surprising, I know — seeing as I can never keep my mouth shut and all.
: Yeah, but you have parts of you that you excel at keeping hidden. Of course you wouldn’t blab about those.
: You have parts just like that too, Sensei...
: So I guess it’s time to start connecting some dots...
: And see the ways in which we line up...
: Question one — how do you feel about me?
: Which one?
: Uta-chan.
: Is that still the one I’m talking to? Because I was under the impression you body-swapped again.
: Then why not tell me how you feel about both? Just starting with Uta-chan.
: I think Uta-chan is the perfect girl. Just like you want her to be.

: I think she’s funny and cute. And way too good at her job. And she drives me insane with her endless cycle of flirting that leads to nothing. Not to mention I’ve spent probably half a million yen on her by now.
: And how do you feel about Uta Ushibori?
: I think she’s a fucking mess.
: I think the complex she’s created in which she can’t function unless there’s a failsafe version of her tucked into her back pocket is juvenile. I think she’s perverted and lacks common sense.
: I think the way she cares for everyone is actually careless since it opens her up to the possibility of being hurt by so many different people.

: I despise that there are so many other men just like me who sit in front of dimly lit computer screens, jerking off to her pictures and I hate that she’s figured out a way to monetize those fantasies at her work.
: I hate so many things about her. It’s infuriating. But it’s like watching a train-wreck...and I can’t look away.
: I like her so, so much more...
: That was a much better answer than the one Ami gave me.
: What’d she say?
: That she used to touch herself in your bed.
: Yeah...that sounds about right.
: I probably should have acted a little more surprised than I did, but...honestly, I kind of had a feeling.
: She doesn’t really do a good job of hiding it, I’ll be the first to admit that.
: But why were you two talking about that in the first place?
: So I would know what to say when the time came to talk to you.
: Question two...
: How did you get them?
: It’s not them. It’s just one.
: Then...how did you get it?
: Like...did you go out of your way to look for my pictures when I told you about them? Because I get them taken down from websites and stuff pretty regularly, but...
: There are probably some I...don’t know about...and stuff...
: I didn’t look for anything. Some...random number sent it to me out of nowhere one day.
: That’s what I was afraid of.
: I mean...isn’t that better than me going out of my way to look for them, though?
: Of course not. Because this means it could happen to anyone.
: I really am never safe, huh?
: You were never supposed to know, Uta. I’m sorry.
: You were really just going to secretly jerk off to it for the rest of forever? What do you mean I was never supposed to know?
: I mean that you should know better than anyone how fucked up it is for me to have something like that in the first-
: Sensei, I took those pictures! I am the last person who should be telling you about how wrong it is. I created this problem. You’re just a dumb boy with really creepy taste.
: But you were just...stupid and needy back then. You had no idea what you were doing. You said it yourself.
: I have no idea what I’m doing today either.
: All logic says I should be totally skeeved out right now.
: I should report you to the police or...tell the rest of the girls about the person you really are. Which, granted, isn’t that much different from who we already know you are.
: And, you know...maybe I kind of am a little grossed out. But I’m also not. I’m also happy.
: You shouldn’t be happy, Uta...

: You think I don’t know that?! Do you think I want to be such a degenerate?! Because my life would be so much friggin’ easier if I wasn’t, Sensei! This wouldn’t have ever been a problem in the first place!
: I have no idea what you want me to say to you right now.
: I was ready for you to cut things off for good. I thought this was going to be the last time we ever came out here.
: You could tell me to my face you’re never coming back and I would still wait for you here.
: That’s how I really feel about you, Sensei.
: Yes, it’s messed up that you never told me about that picture. But it’s also kind of flattering in a...really creepy...super illegal way...
: Just please don’t tell Io I said that. I think she’s kind of expecting me to start hating you or something and I...don’t really know how to tell her I’m sort of...okay with it.
: Just for you, though...
: I wouldn’t do this for anybody else...
: Question three...
: We’re still playing?
: Do you need help?
: ...What?
: Because I think there’s like...
: So there are, like...people you can talk to, I think...
: Me and Io met in a similar kinda way, but...like...
: If there are parts of you that...you want to change...you know, like...if you don’t want to be interested in the...same sort of...stuff anymore...
: Like...I’m not really sure if it’s therapy, or...I don’t know what to call it...
: But if you don’t want to be who you already are anymore...I could try and...help you find a way...
: None of that made sense, did it?
: Sensei?...
: Why does everyone keep trying to help me?...
: I don’t understand...
: I don’t understand!
: I’m doing everything wrong and you still want to help me!
: When will one of you hold me accountable?! Where will any of you draw the line?! Is there no end to what I can do?! Can I seriously do anything I want?! Anything?!
: Sensei! Shh!
The girl from Nara wraps her arms around me.
She must think I have deer parts.
: I can’t speak for anyone else, but I’m stupid...
: Ngh...
: You said it yourself, didn’t you?...
: I’m a fucking mess...I can’t function unless there’s a failsafe version of me tucked into my back pocket...
: I’m a filthy pervert...who lacks common sense...
: There are thousands of men in front of dimly lit computer screens, jerking off to pictures of me...
: But I’m happy that you’re one of them...and I won’t call you a bad person because I don’t have the right to...
: Let’s be stupid together, okay?...
: You’re making a mistake...
: I’ve always been good at that...
: But there are other things I can be good at, Sensei...
: And I want you to find out what those things are with me...
: It doesn’t matter if it’s here or Nara...
: It doesn’t matter if it’s in this life or another...
: I want a future with you...
: I don’t care what shape or size...
: I don’t care if you think you deserve it or not...
: It’s what I want...
: Please...
: Will you let me take a bite out of your heart?...
Uta’s affection has increased by 25!
You decide to keep the picture.
You’ll look at it together one day.
: It’s happening again...
Blackest night, envelop me-\nProtect me from my dreams
For in them, I hear nothing\nNot the cherub, nor its screams
